title: DSPy 3.4 reframes AI systems as programs, not prompt collections
friendlyTitle: DSPy helps developers build AI with clear building blocks
summary: DSPy’s current release presents a structured way to build AI systems from typed signatures, reusable modules and optimizers, with Python interpreter improvements, faster GEPA optimization and MCP v2 compatibility. The framework is designed to make model workflows easier to test, tune and maintain.
friendlySummary: DSPy lets developers describe what goes in, what should come out and how to improve the result instead of managing many hand-written prompts.
whyItMatters: Teams can replace brittle prompt files with explicit inputs, outputs and measurable optimization targets. That makes model changes and quality regressions easier to manage as an application grows.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI features can become easier to test and update. This is useful when a small experiment grows into an important business system.
